module.name: pdfhide
module.description: Content left out of the PDF: shown on the slides (preview, slideshow, presenter, images, PowerPoint, video) but not printed when the deck is exported to PDF. For things that mean nothing on paper, such as a quiz timer, a video or a button. space: auto leaves a blank of the same size in the PDF. Counterpart: @pdfonly.
module.aiSpec:
Wrap content that belongs on the SCREEN but not in the PDF (a handout, a print): a quiz @timer, a @video, an interactive widget, "click here" instructions. It is shown everywhere else (editor preview, slideshow, presenter view, PNG / PowerPoint / video export) and left out only when the deck is exported to PDF or printed.
Parameters: space — none (default): nothing is left in the PDF; what follows moves up. auto: a blank of the same size is left in the PDF.
<!-- @pdfhide --> <!-- @timer tag: q1, minutes: 1, size: lg --> <!-- @end -->
The counterpart @pdfonly shows content ONLY in the PDF. To leave quiz answers out of a handout as framed blanks to write in, use the built-in @answer block instead.

param.name: space
param.label: Space in the PDF
param.desc: none = nothing is left in the PDF; auto = a blank of the same size is left.

snippet.label: Hide in PDF
snippet.text: <!-- @pdfhide --> shown on the slides, left out of the PDF <!-- @end -->
snippet.description: Leave this content out of the PDF export (the slides still show it).
